factValues.name: gr:fact-a941a95a0959dcbe_fv
factValues.value: For the financial year ended 6 August 2024 the limited liability partnership was entitled to exemption from audit under section 477 of the Companies Act 2006 (as applied by the Limited Liability Partnerships (Accounts and Audit) (Application of Companies Act 2006) Regulations 2008) relating to small limited liability partnerships.

factValues.name: gr:fact-5da4fcb04b127e04_fv
factValues.value: The members acknowledge their responsibilities for complying with the requirements of the Act (as applied to limited liability partnerships) with respect to accounting records and the preparation of accounts.

factValues.name: gr:fact-68abd63e67a48f52_fv
factValues.value: These financial statements have been prepared and delivered in accordance with the provisions and special provisions applicable to limited liability partnerships subject to the small limited liability partnerships regime.
